fact: The Ministério da Educação's Anuário da Educação 2021/2022 (Praia, December 2022) publishes school statistics collected continuously from school returns via the SIGE school management platform plus an exhaustive census questionnaire, with social-action data from FICASE; the ministry publishes the yearbook annually.
title: Anuário da Educação 2021/2022
publisher: Ministério da Educação, Direcção Geral de Planeamento, Orçamento e Gestão
